title: Rebuttal of Claim for Diminution in Value
intro: We have been instructed to comment on an example diminution in value assessment.

sections.heading: The Damage and Repairs Were Superficial

blocks.text: The example repair was confined to cosmetic panels and did not compromise the vehicle structure.

sections.heading: No Physical Inspection of the Vehicle

blocks.text: The opposing assessment provides no physical inspection evidence showing a detectable permanent loss.
A percentage-based stigma calculation is not, by itself, reliable evidence of actual market loss.
We do not consider the example claim for diminution in value to be supported by the evidence supplied.
